_comment: Providers the weekly provider review live-probes, and the model each probe sends.
Moved out of scripts/provider_review/probe.py in #5029 so a probe model is data,
not a literal in code: editing a model here is a one-line diff with no code review
of the probing logic attached to it.
base_url      OpenAI-compatible base for the provider.
api_key_env   GitHub org secret holding the key (scripts/provider_review/probe.py).
model         The model the probe sends PROBE_PROMPT to. It must answer with a
short string, so pick a cheap fast model, not the provider's flagship.
The list is deliberately not derived from config/model-catalog.json: that catalog
carries first-party provider metadata and has no row for an OpenAI-compatible
gateway or a free-tier route, so deriving the probe list from it would silently
drop providers. Adding a provider here is a deliberate act.
github_models was removed — platform fully retired 2026-07-30 (#1589).
tests/provider_review/test_probe.py pins the provider set, so removing one is a
test change too, which is the point.
